Eva and Anna had great fun there. The weather was snowy that day. Eva bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Best of all, the departure board flashed a delay.
There are always many people at the bus stop. The travel plan is one of the best places in the city. They took many photos at the bus stop. In fact, there's a new film at the cinema.
Eva learned a lot about art. It takes twenty minutes to get to the travel plan by bike. Eva plays chess with Anna every Tuesday. We walked among the giant redwood trees in California.
Eva wants to be a nurse in the future. Eva thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Life is full of small surprises.
